  why: what the real game's stack holds there ([bp-0x0C] of R009+0x4D56, below the caller's SP) depends on what ran before; the unit oracle's stack (file reads stubbed) shows 0 for the first pile and 0x29CB afterwards. In the whole game (lockstep session dungeon-mine-group run live with R009+0x4EAE hooked) the word was 0 at each of its four pile fills, all first piles of their sections, so the 0x29CB case was not met; a value above 9 means "no new kind picked, the last one repeats", and the word is also the first entry's item (SI) when the first pick lands on it.
